title: Silence is Golden
logline: A station manager tries to force a silent ascetic to break their holy vow to explain how to fix a failing life support system.

roles.description: A former engineer who took a vow of complete silence to atone for a disaster they caused.
Will do absolutely anything to keep the station breathing.
Thinks the ascetic is just a lazy coward avoiding real work.
An aging habitat where the air is starting to taste like copper.
A heavy industrial cutter used by the union for external repairs.

public_situation: The primary life support manifold on {role:failing_station} is collapsing. The {role:silent_ascetic} is the only person who knows how to bypass it.
private_truth: The ascetic knows that bypassing the manifold will vent the station's lower decks into space, killing dozens of poor workers to save the rich.

beats.public_change: The station manager puts the station on emergency rations and grounds all ships.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to bring in raw water ice to buy the station a few more hours of breathable air.
missions.private_fact: The manager is secretly preparing an escape shuttle just in case.

beats.public_change: The union threatens to riot if the ascetic doesn't speak up and fix the system.

missions.reason: The ascetic hands the pilot a sealed, written prayer to deliver to the manager.
missions.private_fact: The prayer is actually a mathematical proof showing that the bypass will kill the lower decks.

beats.public_change: The manager receives the proof, burns it, and orders the union to rip open the ascetic's door.

missions.reason: The manager hires the pilot to fly outside the station and retrieve the manual bypass key from a secure exterior lockbox.
missions.private_fact: The union is watching and waiting.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the bypass key. They can give it to the manager, or hand it over to the union to prevent the purge.

options.label: Give the key to the manager
Give the key to the union

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the key to the manager.
resolutions.summary: The manager forces the bypass. The upper decks survive, but the lower decks are vented into space. The ascetic breaks their vow to scream.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the key to the union.
resolutions.summary: The pilot stops the bypass. The union throws the manager out the airlock and manually repairs the system, saving everyone through grueling labor.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot backed a union strike that saved a whole station from getting vented.

resolutions.summary: The station simply runs out of air. Thousands die quietly while the ascetic prays in silence.

loose_threads.detail: The manager's private escape shuttle was pre-programmed with coordinates to an unmapped corporate black site.
The life support manifold didn't fail from age; it was cleanly sliced by a precision mining laser from the outside.

radio_hooks: Air rationing in effect on {role:failing_station}; union demands action.
Manager of {role:failing_station} blames 'technical gremlins' for oxygen loss.

voice_direction.silent_ascetic: Never speaks. Voice directions apply only to written messages: stark, poetic, fatalistic.
